title: How a Godly Man Takes Correction From a Brother Without Getting Defensive
caption:
Not every guy in your group chat can actually correct you.

Proverbs 27:6 says wounds from a friend can be trusted. Not comfortable. Trusted.

The tell isn't whether it stings when a brother calls you out. It's what you do in the ten seconds after. Defend, or say thank you.

Iron sharpens iron. Sharpening was never supposed to feel good.

Keep the men who tell you the truth.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood #accountability
